canonical.name: The page distinguishes left, right, and biclosed monoidal categories and never treats closedness as automatic or silently symmetric.
The exponential object and the cartesian-closed definition are minted on the A page because the published function-set exponential lives on a B-page leaf.
The preorder consequence is stated as an explicit adjunction law rather than with Heyting terminology, because no published Heyting vocabulary lies below this page.
The subobject-functor representation is stated in the supplied-well-powering form, because on-disk subobjects are class-coded and do not assemble into a literal set without chosen representatives.
The design prose names more prerequisite pages than the live spec does, so this scaffold follows the spec edge and uses the resulting closure rather than adding direct requires locally.
The accessible Riehl PDF numbers the locally cartesian closed material as Section 4.6 and Definition 4.6.2 onward, even though the design note cites Section 4.5.
